WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd, status
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT w.dd, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_sl, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl,
       sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE w.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-25'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT w.dd AS bd, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount AS n
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS bd, s.store_id, p.category, -r.refund_net AS n
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900
),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT bd, sum(n) AS all_net, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS clean_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND n>0 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS sales900,
  sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND n<0 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS rets900,
  (SELECT net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q WHERE q.business_date=u.bd AND q.store_id=900) AS rpt_net,
  (SELECT net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q WHERE q.business_date=u.bd AND q.store_id=900) AS rpt_gross,
  (SELECT returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales q WHERE q.business_date=u.bd AND q.store_id=900) AS rpt_ret
FROM u WHERE bd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.status, count(*) AS orders, count(f.receipt_id) AS lines_joined, min(o.dispatch_ts_utc), sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line) f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-08' AND DATE '2025-12-26'
GROUP BY 1

 (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dup_ret,
 (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) AS dup_sales,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') AS web_rets_in_range,

 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900) AS wb_not_900,

SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net_in_store, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND rs.store_id<>900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT business_date, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
